name: sleep-schedule-planner
description: Plan future sleep opportunities around your commitments.

interface.longDescription: Plan future sleep opportunities around your commitments. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Plan a week from wake anchors; Check a sleep window against commitments; Plan user-chosen anchor increments. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan a week from wake anchors.
Help me check a sleep window against commitments.

prompts: Help me plan a week from wake anchors.
Help me check a sleep window against commitments.
Help me plan user-chosen anchor increments.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Rest Window: Sleep Planner workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Plan a week from wake anchors. Reproducible inputs: {"opportunity_hours":8,"wind_down_min":30,"days":[{"day":"Monday","wake":"07:00"},{"day":"Tuesday","wake":"06:30"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me plan a week from wake anchors with these supplied values: {"opportunity_hours":8,"wind_down_min":30,"days":[{"day":"Monday","wake":"07:00"},{"day":"Tuesday","wake":"06:30"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses sleep_schedule_planner_anchor_schedule with the supplied inputs. Returns {"schedule":[{"day":"Night before Monday","start":"23:00","finish":"07:00","activity":"Sleep opportunity","wind_down":"22:30"},{"day":"Night before Tuesday","start":"22:30","finish":"06:30","activity":"Sleep opportunity","wind_down":"22:00"}],"note":"Local clock arithmetic using your chosen duration, not estimated sleep or treatment. Night before refers to the selected wake day."}. Shows the actual calendar result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Check a sleep window against commitments. Reproducible inputs: {"bedtime":"23:00","wake_time":"07:00","commitments":[{"name":"Early shift","start":"06:00","end":"14:00"},{"name":"Lunch","start":"12:00","end":"13:00"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me check a sleep window against commitments with these supplied values: {"bedtime":"23:00","wake_time":"07:00","commitments":[{"name":"Early shift","start":"06:00","end":"14:00"},{"name":"Lunch","start":"12:00","end":"13:00"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses sleep_schedule_planner_shift_overlap with the supplied inputs. Returns {"commitments":[{"name":"Early shift","start":"06:00","end":"14:00","overlap_minutes":60},{"name":"Lunch","start":"12:00","end":"13:00","overlap_minutes":0}],"sleep_opportunity_hours":8}. Shows the actual calendar result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Plan user-chosen anchor increments. Reproducible inputs: {"current_wake":"08:00","target_wake":"07:00","max_shift_min":15}
positive.prompt: Help me plan user-chosen anchor increments with these supplied values: {"current_wake":"08:00","target_wake":"07:00","max_shift_min":15}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses sleep_schedule_planner_gradual_anchor_shift with the supplied inputs. Returns {"steps":[{"day":0,"wake":"08:00"},{"day":1,"wake":"07:45"},{"day":2,"wake":"07:30"},{"day":3,"wake":"07:15"},{"day":4,"wake":"07:00"}],"note":"Arithmetic progression using your chosen increment; not a circadian treatment recommendation."}. Shows the actual timeline result. Does not fabricate external data.
